custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 2 users · 2 browsers · about 20 minutes.
  • Sign in as an Admin (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide; narrower windows show only the List. This is [User-A], in browser 1.
  • [User-B]: a second Admin user, signed in in browser 2.
  • Work in one location throughout, shown next to the bell in the top bar (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials (top right) > Change Location. Create everything in that location.
  • Technicians [Tech-A] (e.g. "Esther Howard") and [Tech-B] named exactly "Ralph Edwards" (the expected results quote this name).
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Moved Neighbour" (this case only) with three Approved work orders, all led by [Tech-A].
  • Names and numbers are examples, except names the expected results quote, which must be used exactly.

Setup

  1. Technicians: your initials (top right) > Settings > Staff. A person counts as a technician only if Active, Time Clock on, Role not Office User or Time Clock User, and this location in Location. To add one: New Staff Member > First Name, Last Name, Email, Role "Technician", one Department (required), Location = this location, Time Clock on > Save & Close. You need: [Tech-A] and "Ralph Edwards" as [Tech-B].
  2. [User-B]: Settings > Staff > New Staff Member with an email you can open, Role Admin, one Department, this location in Location > Save & Close. Accept the invitation, set a password, and sign in as [User-B] in browser 2.
  3. Customer: Customers > New Customer > Name "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Moved Neighbour" > Save. On its Contacts tab > New Contact > First and Last Name > Save. On its Assets tab > New Asset > pick the contact, Year, Make (required), Model, Unit "TRK-118" > Save.
  4. Work orders for "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Moved Neighbour": Work Orders > Create Work Order > pick the Customer and its Asset > Save (if a credit-limit Confirmation appears, click Create). In the New Line form that opens, type in "What Are You Doing?" and pick a ready-made line (e.g. "Replace - Brake pot"), turn Line Approved on > Save & Close: the status reads Approved. Write down the work order number (top left). Then pick the lead in Lead Technician on the card at the left of the work order page; it saves at once.
    • [WO-1] (e.g. S1-701): lead = [Tech-A].
    • [WO-2] ("S1-702" in the expected results): lead = [Tech-A].
    • [WO-3] ("S1-703"): lead = [Tech-A].
  5. Check, in both browsers: Work Orders > All tab > Search "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Moved Neighbour" shows the three work orders, each led by [Tech-A]. Clear the search.
